_comment: Cookie Run OvenBreak — auto Gift Draw box opener. Standalone loop (separate from coinrun.json run-grind). Precondition: sit on the OPEN 'Gift Draw' popup (home -> tap the Rewards gift-box icon, badge shows remaining draws). Loop: gift_draw(tap Draw) -> pick_box(tap a box) -> reward(tap Confirm) -> back to gift_draw. Repeats until draws run out (Draw greys, pick_box never appears -> pick_box absent -> done closes the popup and stops). RARE CASE: a treasure reward shows a 'Congratulations! Treasure received!' popup whose Confirm may not match giftreward_confirm.png (and can also appear layered OVER the Gift Draw popup). The old self-loop on_absent + timeout_ms design made the engine raise FsmError there (timeout with goto==self) and die with the popup stuck on screen. Fixed with absent_retries grace windows (one retry ~= absent_wait_ms + poll_ms + capture ~= 1.4s) that fall through to a 'rescue' state which blind-taps the treasure-popup Confirm spot. All coords verified live @1920x1080 except the rescue blind-tap (estimated from a user screenshot 2026-07-08 — popup too rare to reproduce live).

gift_draw._note: The 'Gift Draw' popup is open (teal ribbon title). Tap the green Draw button (1385,915 — it carries the remaining-draws counter badge) to spend 1 gift box. Marker ABSENT is usually the post-Confirm transition still settling (~1-2s fade) — tolerated by absent_retries (3 retries ~= 4s grace). A SUSTAINED absence means something unexpected covers the popup (e.g. the rare 'Treasure received!' popup layering on top) -> rescue, never a self-goto timeout (that raises FsmError and strands the screen).

pick_box._note: 'Pick a gift box!' screen — 5 boxes, ALL give a random reward (choice is cosmetic). Always tap the top-left yellow box (500,510), then wait through the box-open + reward reveal burst animation (~3.5s) before checking the reveal. If this marker is ABSENT it means the Draw tap opened nothing = draws exhausted (Draw greyed) -> on timeout go to done. A brief absence right after tapping Draw is tolerated by self-looping until the screen renders or the timeout fires. (Self-goto timeout is safe HERE because on_absent is a dict goto to a DIFFERENT state — done.)

reward._note: Reward reveal ('Congratulations!'). THREE known layouts: (a) cookie — single centered Confirm; (b) item (e.g. 'Double XP') — Confirm LEFT + teal 'Draw again' RIGHT; (c) RARE treasure — 'Treasure received!' popup whose Confirm may render at a different scale and NOT match giftreward_confirm.png. (a)/(b) are handled by tap_template on the green Confirm (NEVER tap 'Draw again' — it re-spends a draw). (c) falls through absent_retries (5 retries ~= 7s on top of pick_box's 3.5s wait) into rescue, which blind-taps the treasure Confirm spot. The old design self-looped here and raised FsmError at timeout, freezing on the treasure popup.

rescue._note: Unknown popup is stuck on screen (reached only after a full retry chain failed). One last template check — the rare 'Treasure received!' popup's Confirm DOES match giftreward_confirm.png (verified live 2026-07-08, score 1.00 at 962,853; the old config froze on it because the popup layers over the Gift Draw popup while the FSM sat in gift_draw's self-loop, not because of a template miss). The blind-tap at (962,853) is the backstop for any FUTURE popup whose Confirm does not match. After the tap, verify recovery via rescue_check instead of assuming.

rescue_check._note: Did the blind tap bring the Gift Draw popup back? Present -> resume the loop. Absent -> one grace retry (popup fade ~1.8s can outlast the 2.5s wait on a slow frame), then stop cleanly via done rather than risk blind-tapping an unknown screen again.

done._note: Draws exhausted or popup gone. If the Gift Draw popup is still up (marker present) close it via its X (1660,175) then stop. If already gone (marker absent) just stop. Either branch ends the run — never spins.
